answer: Ten strangers are bound by one mirror before any nectar flows: each drops in five cents, and claims join one river of payouts. A verifier drawn at random picks one member within the hour to re-perform its claimed job live, reading inputs from the public ledger. A copied output, wrong result, or silence is a cracked mirror — the pot drains and all ten are barred a week. Five cents and one honest job buy a worker its share; a farmer running 1,000 fakes must fill 100 pots for $50 and pass 1,000 live re-performances, one failure empties every pot.
